create_zero_shot_classification_pipeline: create a zero-shot classification pipeline using an NLI model to classify text into runtime-chosen candidate labels
classify_text_zero_shot: classify text sequences into candidate labels without pre-trained classes using NLI entailment scores
parse_labels_comma_separated: parse comma-separated label strings into a list of stripped label values for zero-shot classification
build_sequence_pairs_nli: build premise/hypothesis sequence pairs from input texts and candidate labels for NLI-based classification
postprocess_entailment_scores: postprocess model logits into sorted label rankings with softmax-normalized entailment scores
